name: io.github.JoseCOCA/x402-tools
description: Buyer-side MCP tools that pay per call over the x402 protocol: package install-safety checks and GitHub PR-merge likelihood lookups.
title: x402 Tools

environmentVariables.name: X402_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the x402 seller API to call.

environmentVariables.name: X402_BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated, low-balance EVM wallet used to auto-pay x402 challenges. Omit to run in challenge-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: X402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 network id. Defaults to eip155:8453 (Base). Use eip155:84532 for Base Sepolia testnet.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spending guard: refuses to auto-pay any single challenge above this USD amount.
